tools.name: resend_list_emails
tools.description: List emails sent through the account, newest first, with recipients, subject, and last event (delivered, bounced, etc.). Resend API: GET /emails.

tools.name: resend_get_email
tools.description: Get one sent email by id: sender, recipients, subject, body, timestamps and last event. Resend API: GET /emails/{id}.

tools.name: resend_list_domains
tools.description: List sending domains and their verification status. Only verified domains can send mail. Resend API: GET /domains.

tools.name: resend_get_domain
tools.description: Get one domain: status, region, tracking settings and the DNS records to add. Resend API: GET /domains/{id}.

tools.name: resend_list_api_keys
tools.description: List the account's API keys by name and id (the secret is never returned). Resend API: GET /api-keys.

tools.name: resend_get_usage
tools.description: Get current usage and limits: emails, contacts, segments, broadcasts, domains, and the rate limit. Resend API: GET /usage.

tools.name: resend_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (email, name, unsubscribed flag, custom properties). Resend API: GET /contacts.

tools.name: resend_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id: email, name, unsubscribed flag and custom properties. Resend API: GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: resend_list_audiences
tools.description: List audiences (older contact groups; new work uses segments). Resend API: GET /audiences.

tools.name: resend_list_segments
tools.description: List contact segments (saved groups of contacts) used for broadcasts. Resend API: GET /segments.

tools.name: resend_list_topics
tools.description: List subscription topics: each has a default opt-in or opt-out, used to scope emails to contacts who opted in. Resend API: GET /topics.

tools.name: resend_list_broadcasts
tools.description: List marketing broadcasts (campaigns) with their status. Resend API: GET /broadcasts.

tools.name: resend_list_templates
tools.description: List email templates with their status (draft or published). Resend API: GET /templates.

tools.name: resend_list_webhooks
tools.description: List webhook endpoints and the event types each one receives. Resend API: GET /webhooks.

tools.name: resend_list_logs
tools.description: List recent API request logs (method, path, status, time). Useful to find failed calls such as HTTP 429. Resend API: GET /logs.

tools.name: resend_send_email
tools.description: Send one email from a verified domain, now or at scheduled_at. It reaches real recipients: confirm the content first. Pass idempotency_key on every attempt so a retry cannot send twice. Resend API: POST /emails.

tools.name: resend_cancel_scheduled_email
tools.description: Cancel an email that was scheduled with scheduled_at and not sent yet. Sent mail cannot be cancelled. Resend API: POST /emails/{id}/cancel.

tools.name: resend_create_contact
tools.description: Add a contact by email, with optional name, custom properties and unsubscribed flag. Resend API: POST /contacts.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "resend_list_api_keys" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: List the account's API keys by name and id (the secret is never returned). Resend API: GET /api-keys.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: resend_list_emails, resend_get_email, resend_get_usage, resend_list_contacts, resend_get_contact, resend_list_topics, resend_list_templates · Private data: resend_get_domain, resend_list_api_keys, resend_get_usage, resend_list_contacts, resend_get_contact, resend_list_audiences, resend_list_segments, resend_list_topics, resend_create_contact · Public sink: resend_get_email, resend_list_domains, resend_list_contacts, resend_get_contact, resend_list_templates, resend_list_webhooks, resend_send_email, resend_cancel_scheduled_email, resend_create_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: resend_list_emails, resend_get_email, resend_get_usage, resend_list_contacts, resend_get_contact, resend_list_topics, resend_list_templates · Private data: resend_get_domain, resend_list_api_keys, resend_get_usage, resend_list_contacts, resend_get_contact, resend_list_audiences, resend_list_segments, resend_list_topics, resend_create_contact · Public sink: resend_get_email, resend_list_domains, resend_list_contacts, resend_get_contact, resend_list_templates, resend_list_webhooks, resend_send_email, resend_cancel_scheduled_email, resend_create_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
